topic: How does defocused reflector gain loss impact link budget margins for SNR compared to conventional designs?
consensus_response: Defocused reflector gain loss reduces SNR margins due to inherent gain roll-off and broader patterns, increasing interference. Although it enhances robustness against feed failures, advanced beamforming techniques like MVDR can mitigate effects. Careful system design balances robustness and SNR, necessitating link budget adjustments.
reference_context: Defocused reflectors suffer from gain loss and pattern broadening, affecting SNR and co-polar isolation, but offer improved robustness against feed failures.
